improvements.zh: 双击拆层结果可移动图层、调整顺序和用蒙版修边，并可单独导出每层的透明 PNG 或可编辑 PSD。
improvements.en: Double-click a layered result to move layers, reorder them, and refine edges with a mask. Export any layer as a transparent PNG or editable PSD.

improvements.zh: 多图导入会对齐排列。双击空白处添加节点，双击标题原位改名，还可以下载图片压缩副本。
improvements.en: Import multiple images in an aligned grid. Double-click empty space to add a node or a title to rename it. Images can also be downloaded as compressed copies.

fixes.zh: 改进透明图片和生成进度的显示，并减少换底色等编辑被误判为去背景的情况。
fixes.en: Improved transparent image rendering and progress display. Background color edits are less likely to trigger background removal.
Fixed an unavailable-model error when removing an image background on the canvas.

improvements.zh: 统一创作界面的导航与布局，优化模板、工具、作品及账户页面的使用体验；无限画布和原生参考工作台保持原样。
improvements.en: Unified navigation and layouts improve templates, tools, creations and account pages. The infinite canvas and native reference workbench remain unchanged.

improvements.zh: 统一创作界面的导航与布局，优化模板、工具、作品及账户页面的使用体验；无限画布和原生参考工作台保持原样。
improvements.en: Unified navigation and layouts improve templates, tools, creations and account pages. The infinite canvas and native reference workbench remain unchanged.

title.zh: 创作设置与图片显示优化
title.en: Creation settings and image display improvements

improvements.zh: 首页与画布的图片创作参数保持一致。
improvements.en: Image creation parameters are consistent across the home page and canvas.

fixes.zh: 修复部分图片比例选项缺失的问题。
fixes.en: Fixed missing image aspect-ratio options.

fixes.zh: 提升对话结果图片和模板封面的加载稳定性，恢复部分失效封面。
fixes.en: Improved loading stability for conversation images and template covers, and restored some unavailable covers.

title.zh: 每轮创作与执行过程更新

improvements.zh: 创作设置按每轮独立保存，历史轮次可沿用原设置再次生成。
improvements.en: Creation settings are saved per turn, and previous turns can be regenerated with their original settings.

improvements.zh: 工具执行过程合并展示，生成结果交由你确认。
improvements.en: Tool activity is grouped into a clear progress view, with generated results left for you to review.

title.zh: 创作首页与对话体验更新
title.en: New creation home and conversation experience

improvements.zh: 登录前后使用统一创作首页，快捷进入模板、工具、作品和工作台。
improvements.en: A unified creation home before and after sign-in, with direct access to templates, tools, work and workspaces.

improvements.zh: 侧栏集中查看对话与画布，图片结果可直接带入编辑工具。
improvements.en: Find conversations and canvases in the sidebar and open image results directly in editing tools.

improvements.zh: 新增明暗主题切换，优化移动端布局，切换对话时保留各自草稿。
improvements.en: Switch between light and dark themes, use a refined mobile layout and retain separate conversation drafts.

fixes.zh: 修复部分参考图组合导致提示词读取或保存失败的问题。
fixes.en: Fixed prompt loading and saving failures with certain reference image combinations.

fixes.zh: 修复读取已保存版本失败时，本地未保存内容可能被清空的问题。
fixes.en: Fixed unsaved local content being cleared when loading a saved version fails.

title.zh: 画布工具与结果恢复优化
title.en: Canvas tools and result recovery improvements

improvements.zh: 更清晰地显示图片尺寸，便于检查当前作品。
improvements.en: Image dimensions are clearer for checking your current work.

improvements.zh: 优化画布工具的处理反馈与文字结果展示。
improvements.en: Improved processing feedback and text-result display in canvas tools.

fixes.zh: 修复部分图片工具在确认后未能正常继续处理的问题。
fixes.en: Fixed cases where image tools did not continue correctly after confirmation.

fixes.zh: 改善连接中断后的原任务结果恢复，减少重复操作。
fixes.en: Improved recovery of original task results after connection interruptions, reducing repeated actions.

improvements.zh: 选中图片时，在右上角直接查看原图像素尺寸。
improvements.en: View original pixel dimensions at the top right of selected images.

title.zh: 画布创作与加载体验更新

improvements.zh: 一次生成多张图片时，保留原图并创建独立结果节点与来源连线，方便对比和继续编辑。
improvements.en: Generating multiple images now keeps the original and creates separate result nodes with source connections for comparison and further editing.

improvements.zh: 图片成组后持续显示整体底板与边界，拖动组内图片或底板即可移动整组。
improvements.en: Image groups retain a shared background and border. Drag a member image or the background to move the whole group.

improvements.zh: 区分文字创作与图片反推入口，提示词优化支持预览、应用及取消后保留原输入。
improvements.en: Text creation and image-to-prompt tools now have distinct actions. Prompt optimization supports preview, apply and cancel while preserving the original input.

improvements.zh: 补齐画布工具栏、菜单、弹层及生成状态的亮暗主题显示，画布主题可独立切换。
improvements.en: Canvas toolbars, menus, dialogs and generation states now follow the canvas light or dark theme independently of the surrounding pages.

improvements.zh: 点击上传支持多选图片，切换节点时保留本次画布会话中的参考图草稿。
improvements.en: The upload picker supports multiple images, and reference-image drafts are retained when switching nodes within the current canvas session.

fixes.zh: 复用已加载的图片，减少反复打开项目封面和引用小图时的加载等待与闪白。
fixes.en: Reuse images that are already loaded to reduce loading delays and flashes when reopening project covers and reference thumbnails.

fixes.zh: 改善缓存异常时的图片与作品加载，避免缓存等待拖住已读取的结果，并对损坏图片进行单项重新读取。
fixes.en: Improved image and artwork loading when cached data is unavailable, so cache waits do not hold up available results and damaged images can be fetched individually.

fixes.zh: 减少已看过图片的重复读取，并在缓存恢复后重新利用本地保存的图片。
fixes.en: Reduced repeated reads of recently viewed images and restored use of locally saved images after cache access recovers.

fixes.zh: 修复部分生成结果查询长时间没有响应的问题，短暂连接异常后继续查询原任务。
fixes.en: Fixed some generation-result checks waiting indefinitely, with subsequent checks continuing to follow the original task after brief connection errors.

fixes.zh: 自适应画幅跟随参考图比例，指定画幅优先；遇到不支持的比例时匹配最接近的可用画幅。
fixes.en: Adaptive framing follows the reference image, while an explicit frame takes priority. Unsupported ratios are matched to the nearest available frame.

fixes.zh: 改善部分抠图结果的恢复显示，让已保存结果可继续从原操作读取。
fixes.en: Improved recovery display for some background-removal results so saved outputs can be retrieved through the original operation.

improvements.zh: 精简图片生成中的说明提示，保留结果恢复、异常与必要状态反馈。
improvements.en: Reduced informational notices during image generation while retaining recovery, error and essential status feedback.

fixes.zh: 修复参考图自适应及指定画幅被误拦的问题，优先使用目标画幅并匹配可用比例。
fixes.en: Fixed incorrect aspect-ratio rejections when editing reference images or choosing an output frame.

title.zh: 画布创作与稳定性更新

fixes.zh: 修复部分画布工具的输入范围与历史切换问题，保留当前图片和参考图草稿。
fixes.en: Fixed input scope and history switching in canvas tools while preserving the current image and reference drafts.

fixes.zh: 修复工作台重新打开会话时的异常状态，减少切换会话后的旧内容干扰。
fixes.en: Fixed session reopening states in the workspace and reduced stale updates after switching sessions.

fixes.zh: 改善大图上传时的资源使用，保持原图和预览品质不变。
fixes.en: Improved resource use during large-image uploads without reducing original or preview quality.

fixes.zh: 改善图片任务遇到短暂连接异常时的等待与查询处理。
fixes.en: Improved waiting and status checks when image tasks encounter brief connection errors.

fixes.zh: 优化功能未开放时的页面反馈，减少无效请求与错误提示。
fixes.en: Improve feedback for unavailable features and avoid unnecessary requests and errors.

improvements.zh: 协作空间支持提需、分工、交付与验收，进度和附件统一留存。
improvements.en: Track requests, assignments, deliveries, reviews and attachments in one workspace.

fixes.zh: 优化成员权限和页面入口的一致性，减少无权限页面造成的中断。
fixes.en: Keep member permissions and navigation consistent to reduce interruptions.

title.zh: 大图查看与稳定性修复

fixes.zh: 修复部分已生成的大图在参考工作台中查看失败的问题。
fixes.en: Fixed failures when viewing some large generated images in the reference workspace.

fixes.zh: 减少图片读取异常后的资源占用，改善长时间使用的稳定性。
fixes.en: Reduced resource retention after image-read errors to improve stability during extended use.

title.zh: 画布图片显示与项目浏览优化
title.en: Smoother canvas images and project browsing

improvements.zh: 项目封面改用按需加载的缩略图，减少等待和流量。
improvements.en: Project covers now load thumbnails on demand to reduce waiting and data use.

improvements.zh: 在画布和全部项目之间切换时，保留已加载封面和列表位置。
improvements.en: Loaded covers and list position are retained when switching between the canvas and all projects.

fixes.zh: 修复画布缩放升级图片清晰度时出现短暂白屏的问题。
fixes.en: Fixed brief blank images when zooming upgrades image quality on the canvas.

fixes.zh: 修复已加载图片暂时移出画面再返回时重复清空显示的问题。
fixes.en: Fixed loaded images being cleared when temporarily leaving and re-entering view.

fixes.zh: 高清图片加载较慢时继续显示已有画面，避免白色提示遮住图片。
fixes.en: Existing images remain visible during slow high-resolution loading instead of being covered by a white notice.

improvements.zh: 减少大图结果处理中的重复工作，改善图片交付效率。
improvements.en: Reduced repeated processing of large images for more efficient delivery.

improvements.zh: 加快大量节点首次定位，保留已有画布布局。
improvements.en: Faster initial placement for large groups of nodes while preserving existing canvas layouts.

fixes.zh: 改善部分任务连接异常时的错误反馈。
fixes.en: Improved feedback when a task encounters a connection error.

improvements.zh: 已有图片可在原节点重新生成，并通过版本历史查看、切换和撤销结果。
improvements.en: Regenerate an existing image in place, then review, switch and undo results through version history.

fixes.zh: 修复自动比例下部分生成报价不显示、重试后仍不可用的问题。
fixes.en: Fixed missing generation prices with automatic aspect ratios, including failed price refreshes.

fixes.zh: 修复连续生成或恢复任务时，已完成图片意外移动的问题。
fixes.en: Fixed completed images moving unexpectedly during consecutive generation or task recovery.

fixes.zh: 改善图片生成的参数兼容与失败诊断，减少无明确原因的失败。
fixes.en: Improved image parameter compatibility and failure diagnostics to reduce unexplained failures.

title.zh: 通知公告与创作记录体验升级

improvements.zh: 新增通知按钮，可随时查看产品公告和更新记录。
improvements.en: A new notification button opens product announcements and update history.

improvements.zh: 新增未读数量提示，并支持一键将公告标为已读。
improvements.en: Unread counts and a mark-all-as-read action make updates easier to track.

improvements.zh: 已打开的页面也能发现新公告，无需先刷新正在编辑的画布。
improvements.en: Open pages can discover new announcements without refreshing an in-progress canvas.

improvements.zh: 在同一浏览器中保留已读状态，并同步到其他已打开页面。
improvements.en: Read status is retained in the same browser and synchronized across open tabs.

improvements.zh: 补充早期创作、画布、素材和交互改进记录，按时间集中查看。
improvements.en: Earlier creation, canvas, media and interaction improvements are collected in chronological history.

improvements.zh: 创作详情优先展示生成结果，再查看输入素材。
improvements.en: Creation details show generated results before input media.

improvements.zh: 同一素材的原图和参考用途合并为标签，减少重复图片。
improvements.en: Original-image and reference roles are combined into labels for the same input.

improvements.zh: 处理后输入默认收起，需要对比时再展开查看。
improvements.en: Processed inputs stay collapsed until you want to inspect them.

improvements.zh: 每项画布任务分别展示生成进度，长时间等待时仍有清晰反馈。
improvements.en: Each canvas task shows its own progress with clear feedback during longer waits.

improvements.zh: 生成结果到达前，进度保持在完成之前，避免提前显示完成。
improvements.en: Progress remains below completion until the result is available.

fixes.zh: 修复同一输入图在不同处理环节重复铺满创作详情的问题。
fixes.en: Fixed the same input filling creation details repeatedly across processing steps.

fixes.zh: 素材翻页按合并后的项目计数，避免重复记录占据多页。
fixes.en: Media pagination counts grouped items rather than filling pages with repeated records.

fixes.zh: 不同内容的处理图和蒙版分别保留，查看原始输入时不再混淆。
fixes.en: Distinct processed images and masks remain separate from original inputs.

fixes.zh: 修复部分任务已有完成结果但画布仍停留在等待状态的问题。
fixes.en: Fixed some canvas tasks remaining in a waiting state after completion.

fixes.zh: 修复部分已有结果缺少画布关联与落位的问题。
fixes.en: Fixed missing canvas placement and links for some existing results.

title.zh: 图片任务状态与结果读取优化
title.en: Image task status and result retrieval improvements

fixes.zh: 修复部分图片已完成后任务仍显示等待的问题。
fixes.en: Fixed some image tasks remaining in a waiting state after their result was completed.

fixes.zh: 改善读取原结果图片时对短暂网络中断的处理。
fixes.en: Improved handling of brief network interruptions while retrieving original image results.

title.zh: 图片任务结果读取修复

fixes.zh: 修复上传图片画布首次生成完成后，错误提示任务不存在的问题。
fixes.en: Fixed tasks incorrectly appearing unavailable after the first image completes on an uploaded-image canvas.

fixes.zh: 修复部分已完成图片仍显示排队中的问题，并保留原图片与积分记录。
fixes.en: Fixed some completed images remaining queued while preserving original images and credit records.

fixes.zh: 修复图片已完成后，创作记录仍显示排队中的问题。
fixes.en: Fixed completed images sometimes remaining queued in creation history.

fixes.zh: 修正部分异常任务的已扣积分显示。
fixes.en: Corrected charged-credit displays for some unsuccessful tasks.

fixes.zh: 修复部分图片已生成但结果未显示的问题。
fixes.en: Fixed some generated images not appearing in the results.

fixes.zh: 改善多张图片的结果恢复，避免重复生成已完成的图片。
fixes.en: Improved multi-image recovery to avoid regenerating completed images.

improvements.zh: 按当前选项展示图片所需积分及多张合计。
improvements.en: Show image credits and multi-image totals for your current selection.

fixes.zh: 修复部分图片创作被错误提示阻断的问题。
fixes.en: Fixed an issue where some image creations were incorrectly blocked.

fixes.zh: 修复积分显示为空的问题，并支持重新读取。
fixes.en: Fixed missing credit displays and added a retry action.

title.zh: 创作交互与处理稳定性更新
title.en: Creation workflow and processing stability update

improvements.zh: 画布文字可直接发起图片创作
improvements.en: Start image creation directly from canvas text

improvements.zh: 多图参考用途可自由切换
improvements.en: Switch the purpose of each reference image

fixes.zh: 改善多任务排队时的处理稳定性
fixes.en: Improve processing stability when multiple tasks are queued

improvements.zh: 图片创作使用已确认的报价，减少重复确认。
improvements.en: Image creation keeps the confirmed quote and reduces repeated confirmations.

improvements.zh: 刷新页面后可找回尚未完成的图片任务。
improvements.en: Recover unfinished image tasks after refreshing the page.

fixes.zh: 修复连续创作时部分请求被误拦截的问题。
fixes.en: Fixed incorrect blocking during consecutive image creation.

fixes.zh: 修复临时忙碌导致图片任务提前失败的问题。
fixes.en: Fixed image tasks failing prematurely during temporary load.

improvements.zh: 参考图支持按序号引用，移除图片后会提示缺失引用。
improvements.en: Reference images by number and see missing references after removing an image.

improvements.zh: 对话处理中可继续添加图片，刷新后可恢复处理进度。
improvements.en: Add images while a conversation is processing and restore its progress after a refresh.

fixes.zh: 修复网络波动时图片上传长时间等待的问题。
fixes.en: Reduced long waits when uploading images during temporary connectivity issues.

improvements.zh: 对话中支持连续添加、粘贴和拖入参考图片。
improvements.en: Append, paste or drop reference images during a conversation.

improvements.zh: 多张参考图画幅一致时自动沿用，不一致时可选择画幅。
improvements.en: Keep a shared reference frame automatically or choose one when frames differ.

fixes.zh: 原图查看与下载保留上传文件，参考图适配不改变原始画幅。
fixes.en: Keep the uploaded original for viewing and downloading without changing its composition.

fixes.zh: 排队与待核查状态分开显示，减少误判失败和重复操作。
fixes.en: Distinguish queued requests from tasks awaiting review and avoid duplicate submissions.

improvements.zh: 自动选择可用的生成分辨率，原选档报价保持不变。
improvements.en: Automatically select an available output resolution while keeping the original quoted price.

fixes.zh: 修复部分图片生成因分辨率选项不匹配而被提前阻断的问题。
fixes.en: Fix image generation being blocked by incompatible resolution options.

fixes.zh: 保留原始选择与实际生成档位，减少重复生成。
fixes.en: Keep the selected and actual resolution separate and avoid duplicate submissions.

improvements.zh: 参考图片单次可选择最多16张。
improvements.en: Select up to 16 reference images per request.

fixes.zh: 优化参考图编辑的兼容性。
fixes.en: Improved compatibility for reference-image editing.

fixes.zh: 不支持的画幅会在开始生成前提示，减少无效等待。
fixes.en: Unsupported aspect ratios are reported before submission to avoid unnecessary waiting.

fixes.zh: 区分服务暂时不可用与并发繁忙提示。
fixes.en: Distinguished temporary service unavailability from capacity limits.

improvements.zh: 文字与图片的创作工具栏采用统一布局。
improvements.en: Text and image creation toolbars now share a consistent layout.

fixes.zh: 修复部分图片生成比例不准确的问题。
fixes.en: Fixed inaccurate aspect ratios in some image generations.

fixes.zh: 切换节点时分别保留提示词和参数草稿。
fixes.en: Prompt and parameter drafts are retained separately when switching nodes.

fixes.zh: 生成失败或结果待确认时保留状态卡片，避免进度突然消失。
fixes.en: Status cards remain visible when generation fails or results need confirmation.

improvements.zh: 新增本机3D产品工作台，支持瓶罐盒参数化建模、材质灯光调整与工程导出。
improvements.en: Added a local 3D product workbench with bottle, jar and box modeling, materials, lighting and project export.

improvements.zh: 支持浏览器内瓶体照片近似建模、标准盒展开折叠预览与整圈标签。
improvements.en: Added approximate bottle modeling from photos in the browser, standard carton folding previews and wraparound labels.

improvements.zh: 统一画布图标，改善创作助手的文字实时显示与操作反馈。
improvements.en: Unified canvas icons and improved live assistant text and interaction feedback.

fixes.zh: 作品详情只展示实际保存的提示词，缺失时不再填入示例内容。
fixes.en: Artwork details display saved prompts only, without demo fallback text.

fixes.zh: 编辑图片时按明确参考角色决定自动画幅，并移除重复的创作面板。
fixes.en: Automatic image framing follows explicit reference roles, and duplicate creation controls were removed.

improvements.zh: 新增包装策略创作页，可补充需求、追问、调整并保存方案。
improvements.en: Create packaging strategies with guided questions, revisions and saved projects.

improvements.zh: 支持拖拽或点击导入创作技能文件。
improvements.en: Import creative skill files by dragging or clicking.

improvements.zh: 画布可批量运行选中节点，并显示生成进度。
improvements.en: Run selected canvas nodes in batches and see generation progress.

fixes.zh: 保留手动调整的画布位置，减少生成结果相互遮挡。
fixes.en: Preserve manual canvas positions and reduce overlapping results.

fixes.zh: 改善图片完整展示和切回页面时的加载体验。
fixes.en: Improve full-image presentation and image retention when returning to the page.

title.zh: 参考图上传与创作入口改进
title.en: Reference uploads and creation entry improvements

improvements.zh: 统一普通、桌面和团队创作页面的参考图上传体验。
improvements.en: Reference-image uploads share the same handling across standard, desktop and team views.

improvements.zh: 工作台入口名称更清晰，常用创作入口采用浅色布局。
improvements.en: Clearer workbench labels and a light layout improve access to frequently used tools.

fixes.zh: 修复部分图片上传过程中意外失败的问题。
fixes.en: Fixed unexpected failures during some image uploads.

fixes.zh: 上传异常时给出明确提示，避免出现难以理解的页面内容。
fixes.en: Upload errors show clear messages rather than confusing page content.

fixes.zh: 结果暂未确认时保留原任务，不盲目创建重复请求。
fixes.en: Original tasks are retained when results are unconfirmed instead of blindly creating duplicates.

title.zh: 图片复看与大画布浏览优化

improvements.zh: 在同一浏览器内复看已加载的图片时优先复用已有内容。
improvements.en: Previously loaded images can be reused when revisiting them in the same browser.

improvements.zh: 改善作品页和画布之间切换时的图片加载体验。
improvements.en: Image loading is improved when switching between artwork pages and the canvas.

improvements.zh: 浏览器存储空间不足时，图片仍沿正常读取方式打开。
improvements.en: Images continue to load normally when browser storage space is limited.

fixes.zh: 退出登录后清理对应的本地图片缓存。
fixes.en: Signing out clears the corresponding local image cache.

fixes.zh: 读取失败的内容不作为正常图片缓存，保留重新加载入口。
fixes.en: Failed reads are not cached as successful images and can be retried.

title.zh: 画布图片编辑与透明图片支持
title.en: Canvas image editing and transparent images

improvements.zh: 支持从普通图片节点直接发起透明图片创作。
improvements.en: Transparent-image creation can be started directly from a standard image node.

improvements.zh: 图片工具保留所选素材与编辑关系，便于继续创作。
improvements.en: Image tools retain selected media and editing relationships for continued work.

fixes.zh: 改善图片创作选项与实际执行结果之间的一致性。
fixes.en: Improved consistency between image creation options and the resulting work.

title.zh: 素材上传、预览与原图下载改进
title.en: Media uploads, previews and original downloads

improvements.zh: 支持按可视区域加载画布图片，减少屏幕外素材的无效读取。
improvements.en: Canvas images can load according to the visible area instead of loading off-screen media.

improvements.zh: 缩放画布时按显示尺寸选择图片预览。
improvements.en: Canvas zoom can select previews suited to the displayed image size.

improvements.zh: 保留原图用于下载和后续编辑，不以缩略图替换原始素材。
improvements.en: Original images remain available for download and editing rather than being replaced by thumbnails.

improvements.zh: 支持项目图片打包下载。
improvements.en: Project images can be downloaded together in an archive.

fixes.zh: 改善上传完成后的素材确认，避免同一上传重复形成作品。
fixes.en: Upload completion checks help avoid creating duplicate artworks from one upload.

fixes.zh: 私人素材的查看和下载沿用各自的访问权限。
fixes.en: Private media viewing and downloads retain their access controls.

title.zh: 创作助手与批量工作台更新
title.en: Creative assistant and batch workbench updates

improvements.zh: 创作助手支持实时显示回复，并保留项目内会话记录。
improvements.en: The creative assistant streams replies and retains conversations within projects.

improvements.zh: 支持在项目中重命名并重新打开已有创作会话。
improvements.en: Existing creative conversations can be renamed and reopened within a project.

improvements.zh: 批量工作台支持集中运行并查看各项任务结果。
improvements.en: The batch workbench supports grouped submissions and individual task results.

fixes.zh: 不同项目的创作会话分别保存，减少切换时的混淆。
fixes.en: Creative conversations are stored separately by project to avoid confusion when switching.

fixes.zh: 改善手机尺寸下的创作页面和操作布局。
fixes.en: Improved creation pages and controls at mobile screen sizes.

title.zh: 工作台与模板导航整理

improvements.zh: 模板统一放入工作台，常用入口更集中。
improvements.en: Templates are collected in the workbench for easier access.

improvements.zh: 手机底部导航增加工作台入口。
improvements.en: The mobile bottom navigation includes a workbench entry.

fixes.zh: 移除顶部重复模板入口，同时保留旧链接的跳转。
fixes.en: Removed duplicate template navigation while retaining redirects from older links.
